original_title: US military says it has seized two sanctioned oil tankers

ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Increased scrutiny of maritime traffic in the regions, potential for further seizures or interceptions of sanctioned vessels.
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: Long-term impact on global oil trade and sanctions enforcement, potential escalation of tensions between the US and sanctioned countries.
